name: Kimi
desc: 支持超长上下文的 AI 智能助手
desc_zh: 支持超长上下文的 AI 智能助手
solves: Long documents never get finished, and they do not fit in a prompt box. Kimi reads a lot of material at once and you can question it directly.
solves_zh: 长文档读不完，也塞不进提问框。Kimi 能一次读很长的材料，直接对着它问。
best_for: When you need to read through a long report or a batch of material before asking questions.
best_for_zh: 要通读一份很长的报告或一批资料再提问。
